_comment: Sample game for the commentator TTS mockups. `raw` is the replay engine's entry text exactly as replayController emits it on 'entry'; `say` is the commentator rewrite of that same entry (what an LLM given the entry plus saidSoFar would return). An empty `say` means the commentator chose silence for that entry (possession delimiters). `excite` marks lines the SSML variant reads with raised rate and volume.

entries.say: Welcome to Breakside against Riverside. Breakside will start the game on defense.

entries.raw: Point 1 roster: Alice Bob Cara Dev Eve Finn Gia
entries.say: Point one. On the line for Breakside: Alice, Bob, Cara, Dev, Eve, Finn, and Gia.
Breakside to pull.
Alice with the pull, and it's a good one, deep into Riverside territory.
Riverside working it up the field... and Bob gets a hand on it! Block by Bob!

entries.raw: Bob throws a reset to Cara
entries.say: Bob picks it up and dumps it back to Cara.
Cara winds up and hucks it! Dev comes down with it just short of the goal line.

entries.raw: Dev throws to Alice for the score!
entries.say: Dev to Alice in the end zone. Goal!
That's the break for Breakside.
Breakside leads it, one to nothing.

entries.raw: Point 2 roster: Alice Bob Cara Dev Eve Finn Gia
entries.say: Point two. Same seven for Breakside.
Riverside will pull this time.
Eve catches the pull cleanly.
Eve swings it over to Finn.
Finn across to Gia on the break side.
Gia puts it up for Eve... and it hits the turf. Turnover. Riverside ball.
Riverside works it in and punches it home.
We're all tied up at one.

entries.raw: Point 3 roster: Alice Bob Cara Dev Eve Finn Gia
entries.say: Point three. Breakside sends out the same line.
Breakside pulling.
Cara's pull hangs forever and lands right at the goal line.
Dev reads the throw... layout block! Dev comes up with it!
Dev gets it moving to Bob.

entries.raw: Bob hucks to Alice for the score!
entries.say: Bob sees Alice streaking deep. He puts it up... Alice catches it in the end zone! Goal, Breakside!
Another break for Breakside.
Breakside back in front, two to one.
